env.//: EAS builds the COMMITTED git tree, and mobile/.env is gitignored, so build-time env belongs here. This is a localtunnel URL: the LAN path is unusable on this network because the router has client isolation on. Tunnel URLs change on every restart and EXPO_PUBLIC_* is baked in at build time, so a tunnel restart costs a full rebuild - keep the tunnel alive. Phase 3.5 replaces this with the deployed URL.
